link.title: Tutorials for Bitbybit Apps
link.description: Every setting on the BITBYBIT APPS theme block, the one that embeds a full interactive configurator into a Shopify page. This is the block to use when a customer needs to change options and see the model react, as opposed to simply viewing it. These pages document each field it exposes - which project or script it runs, how the canvas is sized, how the option panel is positioned, and how it connects to the product and its variants - so you can configure it precisely rather than by trial and error.
